question: Select the synonym of Abstruse.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Difficult**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abstruse"** means something that is difficult to understand or obscure. (जटिल, कठिन)

 
 
• **Example:** Quantum physics is an abstruse subject for most people.
 
 
 
• **"Difficult"** refers to something that requires effort or skill to accomplish, understand, or deal with. (कठिन)
 
 
• **Example:** The exam was so difficult that only a few students managed to pass.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **'Abstruse' **is **'Difficult'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Difficult**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Obvious** (स्पष्ट): Easily seen, understood, or recognized.

 
 
• **Example:** It was obvious that she was upset from her tone.
 
 
 
• **Simple** (सरल): Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were simple and easy to follow.
 
 
 
• **Clear** (स्पष्ट): Free from confusion or uncertainty; easy to perceive or understand.
 
 
• **Example:** His explanation was clear and concise.
